provenance.method: Five individually authored adjudications after reading each complete local case and its enclosing named record or section; no verdict or reason was generated from regexes, ActorAttribution, AttributionNote, or finding kind.
provenance.serialization: Hand-authored JSON; no generator script used.

rows.caseIdentityEvidence: The enclosing record begins 百丈懷海禪師語錄 and continues with 百丈's exchanges; the immediately preceding episode also addresses him as 和尚 and marks his turns 師云.
rows.exactHeadwordClause: 有一僧哭入法堂，師云：作什麼？僧云：父母俱喪，請師揀日。師云：明日一時埋却。
rows.ownershipEvidence: 有一僧哭入法堂 is third-person event narration. The following 師云：作什麼 begins Baizhang Huaihai's reply only after 法堂 has occurred.
rows.reason: MasterName correctly remains null because nobody utters 法堂, but the saved row omits the fully nameable responding and record-owning master, Baizhang Huaihai, from ContextMasters. The nearby 師云 is not a reason to put him in MasterName.
rows.definitionProseImpact: ATTRIBUTION_ONLY. The narrated entry into the teaching hall still supports 'the teaching hall'; the definition and explanatory prose hold. Add Baizhang Huaihai only as contextual respondent/record-owner.

rows.caseIdentityEvidence: The section is 問答機緣 in 明覺聰禪師語錄; within the complete exercise the record owner is the 師 who asks the assembled officers for 下語.
rows.exactHeadwordClause: 一日班首進方丈，師問：如何是空刦已前事？諸子下語看。首座云：炎炎六月一片雪。西堂云：無毛鷂子潑空飛。後堂云：烏󱷐向火碓嘴生花。堂主云：沒底鐵船水上浮。
rows.ownershipEvidence: The parallel labels 首座云／西堂云／後堂云／堂主云 identify successive office-holders. 後堂 is the recorder's label for the third respondent; that respondent's utterance begins only after 云, with 烏󱷐向火碓嘴生花. 師問 identifies Mingjue Cong as the questioner who set the exercise.
rows.otherActor: an unnamed monk holding the rear-hall office answers after the label 後堂云
rows.reason: The saved row calls the actor an unnamed questioner, but 後堂 is not in a question and is not spoken by the rear-hall officer. It is the recorder's role label. Mingjue Cong is nameable as the master who asks the question, but is contextual rather than the utterer of 後堂.
rows.definitionProseImpact: ATTRIBUTION_ONLY. The office-label use directly supports 'rear-hall officer'; the lexical definition holds. Rewrite actor metadata and name Mingjue Cong in context.

rows.caseIdentityEvidence: The enclosing section heading is 明州天童山新禪師, identifying Tiantong Shanxin as 師.
rows.exactHeadwordClause: 上堂，僧問：可來白雲裏，教儞紫芝謌。如何是紫芝歌？師撫掌對之。
rows.ownershipEvidence: 僧問 opens the headword-bearing turn and both 紫芝 occurrences precede its closing question mark. 師撫掌對之 then marks Tiantong Shanxin's nonverbal response as a separate turn.
rows.reason: The current row assigns MasterName=Tiantong Shanxin, but he does not utter 紫芝; the monk does. Tiantong responds by clapping and belongs only in ContextMasters.
rows.definitionProseImpact: ATTRIBUTION_ONLY. The monk's repeated question still attests the song/name deployment represented by the entry; the definition and prose hold after moving Tiantong Shanxin out of MasterName.

rows.caseIdentityEvidence: The complete 沙彌得度 ritual is prescriptive compilation, with role cues 引請／戒師云 and the novice's responses embedded as notes; it is not a named master's personal record.
rows.exactHeadwordClause: There is no genuine 沙彌戒 clause at this location. The XML reads: 戒師云。善男子。沙彌<note place="inline">應喏</note>　戒師云。心源湛寂法海淵深。
rows.ownershipEvidence: 沙彌 is the precept master's vocative to the novice; the intervening inline note 應喏 records the novice's response. A new role cue 戒師云 then starts the next speech. Apparatus-stripping and whitespace removal falsely join 沙彌 + 戒 into 沙彌戒 across that boundary.
rows.specificActor: none for the purported headword; the match is a normalization-boundary artifact
rows.otherActor: an unnamed precept master speaks on both sides of the novice's noted response
rows.reason: This is not merely an attribution problem: the selected corpus span does not deploy 沙彌戒 as a lexical unit at all. It must not be repaired by naming the 戒師; the occurrence must be replaced with a real contiguous attestation.
rows.definitionProseImpact: EVIDENCE_ROW_INVALID; DEFINITION NOT DISPROVED. Other genuine occurrences can still support 'novice precepts', but this witness contributes nothing and any prose claim tied specifically to it must be re-anchored.

rows.caseIdentityEvidence: The section heading 照起二大師請普說 names the two requesting interlocutors collectively; the repeated 師云 belongs to Dahui Zonggao, whose 普說 record this is.
rows.exactHeadwordClause: 進云：雖然因語識人，爭奈摸索他不著。師云：他是阿誰摸索不著？進云：鷺鷥立雪非同色，明月蘆花不似他。師云：你却做得天童侍者。
rows.ownershipEvidence: 進云 marks the interlocutor's continued turn containing 鷺鷥立雪; the following 師云：你却做得天童侍者 marks Dahui's response. The section identifies the interlocutor only as one of 照起二大師, not which of the two at this turn.
rows.specificActor: one of the two requesting masters abbreviated collectively as 照起二大師, not individually distinguishable in this turn
rows.reason: The nearby 師云 belongs to Dahui's answer after the headword-bearing 進云 turn. Leaving MasterName null and naming Dahui only as contextual respondent is correct; the full case does not justify choosing one of the two abbreviated requesting masters as exact speaker.
rows.definitionProseImpact: HOLDS. The interlocutor explicitly deploys the complete paired saying and Dahui answers it; neither the definition nor prose needs semantic revision.
